name: faq-accordion
description: FAQ 问答：问句反白条 + 答句渐入（产品答疑镜）
css: #tpl-faq-accordion { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8vw; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); gap: 3vh; } .fq-q { background: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); color: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); padding: 1.6vh 2.4vh; font-size: 3vh; font-weight: 800; border-radius: 10px; width: fit-content; max-width: 84%; } .fq-a { font-size: 2.4vh; line-height: 1.55; opacity: .85; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); padding-left: 2.4vh; }
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .fq-q", { y: 40, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, {start});tl.fromTo("{tpl} .fq-a", { y: 30, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, {start} + 0.45);
